description: This file defines the RepositoryDao interface and its internal implementation RepositoryDaoInt for database operations related to repositories in the FDroid app, including insert, update, delete, and query methods, with support for diffing and reordering repositories.

classes.name: RepositoryDao
classes.description: Interface defining database operations for repositories.

classes.name: RepositoryDaoInt
classes.description: Internal implementation of RepositoryDao with actual database query annotations and transaction management.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new InitialRepository from a fixture and returns its repoId.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new repository into the database and returns its repoId.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Retrieves a repository by its repoId.

methods.name: getRepositories
methods.description: Retrieves all repositories as a list.

methods.name: getLiveRepositories
methods.description: Retrieves all repositories as LiveData.

methods.name: getLiveCategories
methods.description: Retrieves all categories as LiveData.

methods.name: getAntiFeaturesFlow
methods.description: Retrieves all anti-features as Flow.

methods.name: setRepositoryEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a repository.

methods.name: updateUserMirrors
methods.description: Updates user-defined mirrors for a repository.

methods.name: updateUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Updates authentication info for a repository.

methods.name: updateDisabledMirrors
methods.description: Updates disabled mirrors for a repository.

methods.name: deleteRepository
methods.description: Deletes a repository and its associated data.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Removes all repositories and preferences.

methods.name: walCheckpoint
methods.description: Performs a WAL checkpoint on the database.

methods.name: insertOrReplace
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a CoreRepository.

methods.name: getMinRepositoryWeight
methods.description: Returns the minimum repository weight.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a repository with data from RepoV2.

methods.name: updateRepository
methods.description: Updates a CoreRepository.

methods.name: updateRepositoryPreferences
methods.description: Updates repository preferences.

methods.name: updateRepository
methods.description: Updates a repository with a JSON diff.

methods.name: setRepositoryEnabledInternal
methods.description: Internal method to set repository enabled state.

methods.name: resetPreferredRepoInAppPrefs
methods.description: Resets preferred repo in app preferences.

methods.name: reorderRepositories
methods.description: Reorders repositories based on weights.

methods.name: setWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight of a repository.

methods.name: shiftRepoWeights
methods.description: Shifts repository weights within a range.

methods.name: getArchiveRepoId
methods.description: Gets the archive repo ID for a certificate.

methods.name: trackRepoUpdateError
methods.description: Tracks an error during repo update.

methods.name: resetRepoUpdateError
methods.description: Resets error count and message for a repo.

methods.name: deleteCoreRepository
methods.description: Deletes core repository data.

methods.name: deleteRepositoryPreferences
methods.description: Deletes repository preferences.

methods.name: deleteAllCoreRepositories
methods.description: Deletes all core repositories.

methods.name: deleteAllRepositoryPreferences
methods.description: Deletes all repository preferences.

methods.name: countMirrors
methods.description: Counts mirror entries for testing.

methods.name: countAntiFeatures
methods.description: Counts anti-feature entries for testing.

methods.name: countCategories
methods.description: Counts category entries for testing.

methods.name: countReleaseChannels
methods.description: Counts release channel entries for testing.

methods.name: rawCheckpoint
methods.description: Performs a raw database checkpoint.
